messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: gateway-us-west — elevated 5xx and TCP timeouts. Alerting on-call. Links: https://internal.monitoring/gw-us-west/1769954321

maria.g: on call for infra, looking now. seeing spike in 502/504s, approx 18% error rate on /v1/generate — customers affected: a subset of hosted API traffic to us-west.

tess.w: noticed surge at the edge too, fanout to caches spiking. Could be backend kv thrash.

samir.k: grabbing logs from ingress: `curl https://logs.service/query?q=gw:*us-west* AND status:5xx --last 15m` — lots of `upstream reset` and `connection timed out` errors.

jay.r: any recent deploys?

maria.g: no user-facing deploys in last 30m. infra autoscaler did scale some pools 10m ago.

ellen-cs: multiple customer support tickets incoming for ~10 customers, some reporting 502 on long-running requests. flagged high priority.

samir.k: quick mitigation proposal: 1) reduce fanout concurrency at edge (drop max_parallel  to 6), 2) short-circuit to smaller model variant for high-latency requests, 3) enable region fallback to us-east for new requests.

maria.g: agree. I'm going to flip edge concurrency limiter to 6 now. Doing `/infractl set edge.max_parallel 6 --scope us-west`

ops-bot: deployment job started: infractl-change-1769954321 by maria.g

maria.g: done — limiter lowered. Watch KVs, they should get less pressure.

tess.w: rolling short-circuit policy to use model-id `redwood-compact-v1` for requests with |prompt_tokens| > 800 — doing canary 1%.

samir.k: also temporarily increase proxy connection timeout to 30s to reduce flaps: `kubectl patch cm proxy-config -p '{"timeout":"30s"}'` then restart proxy pods one at a time.

ops-bot: canary rollout succeeded (1% -> 5%).

jay.r: traffic to fallback region initiated for new sessions. old sessions keep pinned.

maria.g: error rate dropped to ~9% after limiter and short-circuit. still above baseline but trending down.

tess.w: great. customer impact window about 22 minutes so far. CS notified customers A, B, C — see support tickets.

samir.k: collecting traces for a suspect upstream (kv-cache-primary-us-west-az2). Getting `ec2 i/o wait` spikes. Could be noisy neighbor.

ellen-cs: customers report degraded latency more than outright failures for some flows. not all customers.

jay.r: next step: schedule a rolling restart of kv-cache-primary pods in AZ2. will drain connections gracefully.

maria.g: initiating controlled restart now, one pod at a time, 30s drain.

ops-bot: restart-job-1769954321 started by maria.g

samir.k: restart done for pod kv-3. I see error tailing off. metrics show p95 latency returning to normal.

maria.g: good. I'm going to revert proxy timeout to normal after traffic stabilizes.

ops-bot: change infractl-change-1769954321 completed.

maria.g: rolling back the short-circuit canary now to 0% and will keep fallback in place for 10 more minutes.

tess.w: alert updates: current alert `gw-5xx-rate-us-west` fired at 1769954321 — we should reduce noise and add a secondary condition for sustained >10% over 5m. create follow-up.

samir.k: creating a quick hotfix PR to add circuit-breaker tuning (lower threshold and longer cool-down) to gateway config. PR: https://stash/repo/pulls/4321

jay.r: +1. Also adding a runbook note: if kv-cache AZ shows i/o wait > 80% and 5xx > 10%, do limiter -> short-circuit -> restart pods.

ellen-cs: filing a customer impact summary for support and BD: downtime window 00:22 - mitigated to degraded service; high severity for 10 customers, medium for ~30. ticket #INC-98765.

maria.g: post-incident actions: 1) hotfix PR and rollout (samir), 2) runbook update with explicit steps and thresholds (jay), 3) alert tuning (tess), 4) customer RCA draft (ellen), 5) schedule 30-min review meeting tomorrow 10:00 PST (maria). I'll assign owners.

samir.k: hotfix merged and canary applied. Monitoring for regressions.

tess.w: adjusting alert rule: change `gw-5xx-rate-us-west` threshold to 12% sustained over 5m and add `kv-cache-iowait > 70%` as a correlated signal. Will push change after review.

jay.r: updated runbook section: `If gateway 5xx > 10% and kv-cache iowait > 70% -> reduce edge.parallel to 6, short-circuit long requests, restart kv pods in affected AZ, enable fallback region.` PR: https://docs/repo/pulls/215

ellen-cs: customer comms draft uploaded to drive: https://drive.internal/incident/INC-98765/comm.md — please review.

maria.g: closing the live thread. If anyone sees recurrence reopen channel. Thanks everyone for quick mitigation. :heart:

ops-bot: INCIDENT resolved. Summary: root cause suspected kv-cache AZ I/O contention causing upstream resets, mitigations: edge concurrency limiter, short-circuit to compact model, restart of kv pods, proxy timeout adjustment. Actions created: INC-98765 (customer RCA), TASK-778 (runbook update), TASK-779 (alert tuning), MEET-342 (postmortem).
